name: Exp Builder Draft Or Refine Text
description: Creates or revises text in the Text Block component on enhanced Lightning Web Runtime (LWR) sites in Experience Builder.

To access Experience Builder:.description: Create and Set Up Experiences AND View Setup and Configuration AND be a member of the site OR View Setup and Configuration AND be a member of the site AND have appropriate role-based site access

To execute actions in Experience Builder.description: A permission set or profile that includes access to the Experience Builder Agent

Required Setup.description: Set Up Agentforce for Experience Builder
